name: databases/
reason: Default's flow_database, where Android's Room keeps a bare name; another profile's opens through ProfileFiles.database.

name: WKWebsiteDataStore(forIdentifier:)
reason: A profile's own WebKit data store, Android's app_webview_<id>; Default keeps WebKit's default store.

name: no_backup/
reason: The no_backup root itself, Android's noBackupFilesDir, left out of backups; ProfileFiles places what goes in it.

name: fake_stream_wall, fake_stream_wall_all
reason: Debug switch files; upstream's FakeStreamWallDataSource.kt row, the wall split from Media3's data source on iOS.
